messages.en: Not yet. We just need to check the report. It'll be done this afternoon.
What stage is that application at now?
It's at the final stage. Just waiting for approval.
Which tribe lives in the forest in that story?
The one with the bird symbol. I've already read the chapter about them.

senses.en_definition: A respectful title or form of address for an adult woman, traditionally a married woman.
A gold or silver container for betel-chewing ingredients, used in royal or traditional wedding ceremonies.

messages.en: Your cake's ready, ma'am. What time would you like to pick it up?
I finish work at five. If I get there around half past five, will I still be in time to pick it up?
Yes, ma'am. We close at six. Just give us your name when you get here.
